query: For my 54-year-old female patient: among females 49–59 with pneumonia, what's the 25th percentile length of stay per admission (days)?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los) AS percentile_25 FROM admissions JOIN icustays ON admissions.hadm_id = icustays.subject_id JOIN patients ON admissions.subject_id = patients.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_age = 54 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admissions.admittime) BETWEEN 1999 AND 2000 AND icustays.los IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM microbiologyevents WHERE microbiologyevents.subject_id = admissions.subject_id AND microbiologyevents.micro_specimen_id IN (SELECT micro_specimen_id FROM microbiologyevents WHERE diagnoses_icd.icd_code = '426')) > 0;
